tagline: From Fragmented Care To A Flourishing Health Journey Wrapped In Care.
tagline_highlight: We Call It Your Health Quilt.
description:
Your Health Quilt is your connected health data paired with your personal Quilt Health Advisor.

It’s where all the pieces of your health come together. Medical history, lab testing with insightful results, and personalized care — all designed to work seamlessly in your preferred language.

Consider us your doctor in the family.

data_collection.title: Data Collection
data_collection.description: Quilt Health collects and securely stores your health information to provide personalized care. This includes your profile, medical history, screening results, lab tests, and consultation data.

data_sharing.title: Data Sharing
data_sharing.description: Quilt Health shares your information with your care providers to ensure coordinated care. We may also use de-identified data for research and service improvement. We never sell your data.

consent.withdraw_note: You can withdraw consent at any time from your profile settings

consultWithDoctors: Consult with board-certified doctors anytime, anywhere.
